# Setup: macOS

macOS is supported but **not tested regularly**. Linux is the primary platform.

## 1. Install dependencies

Using [Homebrew](https://brew.sh/):

```bash
brew install cmake sdl2
```

The Xcode Command Line Tools provide the compiler:

```bash
xcode-select --install
```

## 2. Clone and build

```bash
git clone https://github.com/FreeOpenSourceSyndicate/FreeOpenSourceSyndicate.git
cd FOSSynd
./scripts/build.sh
```

## 3. Run

```bash
./build/src/FOSSynd
```

Controls (prototype): left-click a tile to move the selected agent, **1-8** to
select an agent (or **A** for all), arrow keys to scroll, **Space** to pause,
**Esc** to quit.

## 4. Test

```bash
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```

## Core-only build

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DFOSSYND_BUILD_GAME=OFF
cmake --build build -j
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```

## Troubleshooting

### `SDL2 not found`

Homebrew installs SDL2 under its prefix. If CMake does not find it, pass the
prefix explicitly:

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DFOSSYND_BUILD_GAME=ON -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="$(brew --prefix sdl2)"
```

### Apple Silicon vs Intel

Homebrew prefixes differ (`/opt/homebrew` vs `/usr/local`). `brew --prefix sdl2`
returns the right one.
